title: Why is this big dog so scared of the cat? 🧐🐶🐱 #funny #dog #shorts
description:
🐶😂 Meet Chuck Norris, the tough guy who finally met his match… CATS! 🐱❤️

At first, he couldn’t even look them in the eyes! 👀 Then came the shaking, the awkward moments, and Garfield, the fearless cat who just wanted to be friends! 😂

Watch until the end to see Chuck Norris finally give in! 🥹❤️
